title: Command manifest consistency: declared, registered, allowlisted and menu-referenced ids
scenario: 1) Static, no VS Code host: scan every .ts under src (excluding src/webview) for registerCommand('<id>' with optional whitespace/newline after the paren; assert each contributes.commands id appears in a registerCommand call. 2) Reverse direction: assert each registered id is in contributes.commands or a small allowlist in the test (known internal-only: reltio.revealInTreeView, takes a nodeId arg). 3) Walk every contributes.menus group entry with a command field and every command: link in viewsWelcome contents; assert each id is declared and registered (ACT-001 set).
expected: 1) Zero declared-but-unregistered ids (today all 80 are registered); a new command without a handler fails with the id named. 2) Only allowlisted ids are registered-but-undeclared; a new handler with no package.json entry fails unless added to the allowlist deliberately. 3) No dangling menu or welcome-link command; renaming a command without updating menus fails.

title: Stub-driven activate: Reltio document matching, rebuild triggers, trusted hosts, Classic UX
scenario: 1) isReltioDocument is private; fire the captured onDidChangeActiveTextEditor listener with x.reltio.json, L3.json, l3.json, BusinessConfig.json, businessconfig.json, package.json, a.bpmn and observe whether the uriIndex/diagnostics rebuild runs. 2) With fake timers: two quick onDidChangeTextDocument events on a Reltio doc (one rebuild after DEBOUNCE_MS), an active-editor change (immediate rebuild), activation with an active Reltio editor (one startup rebuild); non-Reltio docs none. 3) getConfiguration returns ['example.test'] for reltio.trustedHostSuffixes: setTrustedHostSuffixes receives it before other setup, default is ['reltio.com'], onDidChangeConfiguration re-applies only when affectsConfiguration is true for that key. 4) With a workspace folder and reltio.uxMode 'classic' vs 'default' (empty tenant folder), count StatusBarController item creation and openSetupGuidePanel calls.
expected: 1) Rebuild runs for *.reltio.json, L3.json and BusinessConfig.json (basename case-insensitive, forward-slash paths), not for package.json; BPMN files take the BPMN diagnostics branch. 2) Rebuild counts 1, 1 and 1; tree provider onL3DocumentChanged called per edit event; no rebuild for non-Reltio docs. 3) Allowlist is set synchronously at activation start and tracks live setting changes, so no token is attached under a stale host list. 4) classic: no status bar item and no guide panel; default: status bar created and guide opened once for a workspace with zero environments.

scenario: 1) Matrix of applyDefaultsOnActivate false/true x isTrusted false/true x folder present/absent, spying on the apply-defaults path; also make the apply throw once. 2) Fake SecretStorage holds refresh tokens for 3 environments with a stubbed refresh endpoint: A succeeds, B has no client credentials, C fails the refresh; await the background restore. 3) In turn make migrateWorkspace reject, syncReltioAgentAssets reject, scanEnvironments reject inside session restore, and runApplyDefaultEnvironments reject; capture showWarningMessage and console.error.

NOTE: the plain debounceTimer for rebuildUriIndex is not in subscriptions today, so expect it to fire; decide whether to fix or document before implementing. 2) Characterize current behavior: .reltio.json matches with backslashes; L3.json / BusinessConfig.json by basename use split(/[\/]/) which only splits on forward slash, so backslash paths may not match. Confirm intent with the owner before pinning.
